title: Chepkirui retains title at Nagoya Women's Marathon
weather: Cool and windy: 9C at the start, with steady wind along the course.

story.W: A lead pack of eight reached 10 km in 33:10 and six were left at halfway (1:10:51). Rino Goshima dropped off around 30 km, and with about 7 km to go four remained before Sheila Chepkirui and Sayaka Sato broke clear. They ran together until Chepkirui edged ahead in the last kilometres and won by two seconds in 2:21:54.

performances.name: Sheila CHEPKIRUI
performances.note: Won a second straight Nagoya title in 2:21:54, well short of her best of 2:17:29.

performances.name: Sayaka SATO
performances.note: Ran stride for stride with the winner in the closing stages and was second, two seconds back.

performances.name: Aynalem DESTA
performances.note: Third in 2:22:37; lost touch with the leading pair with about 7 km to go.

performances.name: Rika KASEDA
performances.note: Fourth in 2:22:53, under the Japanese qualifying standard of 2:23:30 for the LA 2028 Marathon Grand Championship; lost touch with the front with about 7 km left.

performances.name: Natsuki OMORI
performances.note: Fifth in 2:23:45, fell back after 30 km and missed the 2:23:30 standard.

performances.name: Rino GOSHIMA
performances.note: Dropped from the lead pack around 30 km; finished seventh in 2:24:44.
